snippet.title: Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Complete Edition - Game Overview
snippet.description:
Take a closer look at the updates and enhancements we've made in Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Complete Edition, from new and improved graphics, lighting and textures to UI improvements, the addition of modern controls, and more. Featuring interviews with our development partners at Mataboo to give us an even deeper look at the development of the Complete Edition.

For a more comprehensive look at the changes and enhancements we're bringing to Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Complete Edition, check out our blog here: https://news.totalwar.com/s2ce-whats-new
 
Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Complete Edition is launching on October 13th.
Wishlist now: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846830/Total_War_SHOGUN_2__Complete_Edition
Microsoft Store: https://xbox.com/games/store/apps/9nxhdts5svrc
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/total-war-shogun-2-complete-edition-7c956c
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/total_war_shogun_2_complete_edition
